## Mobix Labs Secures $1 Million-Plus Threat-Detection Sensor Order


September 17, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.mobixlabs.com/node/9521/pdf)


*Follow-On Production Order Supports Next-Generation Security Platform*


IRVINE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 17, 2026--[Mobix Labs, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mobixlabs.com&esheet=54605639&newsitemid=20260917414529&lan=en-US&anchor=Mobix+Labs%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=ac9e84cfcc91e5afd41e6777a699227a) (Nasdaq: MOBX) today announced a multi-unit follow-on production order in excess of $1 million for advanced RF sensing subsystems from a leading security-technology provider.


The order, placed with the company’s[RaGE Systems division](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fragesystems.com%2F&esheet=54605639&newsitemid=20260917414529&lan=en-US&anchor=RaGE+Systems+division&index=2&md5=4ed161e817924ed1caf8fbe4f81a21f2) , supports a U.S. government security program focused on detecting concealed threats. Multiple Mobix Labs sensing subsystems are integrated into each of the customer’s next-generation threat-detection platforms.


The order follows previous production orders for the same program and reflects growing worldwide demand for advanced threat-detection platforms, in which these sensors are a critical component.


The subsystems are designed and manufactured in the United States as Mobix Labs continues expanding its security, defense and mission-critical electronics business.
